framing.lineOfInquiry: Pooja Singh (P00006) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE030
framing.alternate: Pooja Singh (P00006) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Was elsewhere at the time (alibi)
alternateHypotheses.statement: Pooja Singh was somewhere else when the incident happened.
alternateHypotheses.label: Strong

evidence.text: Recorded at Sadar Bazaar, Ambala Cantt, 193.3 km from the scene, 31 min before the incident — could not have reached the scene by road in that time

alternateHypotheses.test: Verify the alibi record independently (CCTV, witnesses or receipts at that place and time) and check whether the device could have been carried by someone else.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Pooja Singh was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: Recorded in the FIR as witness, not as accused

alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: Mistaken identity
alternateHypotheses.statement: Records belonging to someone else (a namesake or a wrongly matched profile) were attributed to Pooja Singh.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak

evidence.text: 1 other person record(s) share the name 'Pooja Singh' (P00005), so name-based records can be misattributed

alternateHypotheses.test: Confirm identity with photograph or fingerprints (NAFIS), father's name and address from the FIR particulars.

alternatesConsideredNotSupported.title: Was near the scene for a routine reason

comparison.verdict: The alibi alternate (A1) is currently better supported than the line of inquiry: records place Pooja Singh elsewhere and none place them at the scene.

confidence.note: Evidential balance compares weighted supporting vs contradicting evidence; it is not a probability of guilt. Prior records are excluded from this score.

note: Each hypothesis is tested from both sides to reduce confirmation bias. Confidence scores are evidential balance (not probability of guilt). Human review is required.
